prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need performance marketing, SEO, creative work, product/UX-driven acquisition, or enterprise-level digital transformation.

Quick recommendations by need (San Francisco presence or strong Bay‑Area track record)
- Performance marketing / paid media: 3Q Digital — strong PPC/display/paid social + analytics.
- Growth marketing / startups: SingleGrain — growth experiments, paid acquisition and content.
- Creative / brand + digital product: R/GA or AKQA — enterprise creative, UX and brand work.
- Analytics & media implementation: Jellyfish — data-driven media and measurement.
- Enterprise digital transformation / consultancy: Accenture Interactive / Deloitte Digital — if you need large-scale integrations and strategy.

How to pick the best agency for you
- Match services to goals: SEO, paid acquisition, content, product-led growth, brand/creative, analytics.
- Look for demonstrated KPIs and case studies in your industry and company-size.
- Check transparency: reporting cadence, dashboard access, KPIs, and billing model.
- Team fit: who will do the work (in-house team vs contractors), senior involvement, communication style.
- Budget & timeline: hourly vs retainer vs performance, and realistic timelines for results.
- References: ask for client references and recent results for similar projects.

If you want, I can:
- Build a tailored shortlist of 4–6 San Francisco agencies matched to your goals and budget (with specialties, sample pricing ranges, and recent case studies), or
- Provide an RFP template and interview questions to evaluate agencies.

Tell me: what are your top goals (e.g., increase MQLs, lower CAC, rank for keywords, rebrand), monthly budget range, company size/industry, and preferred timeline — and I’ll put together a short, practical shortlist.
